TEXT.citation: Gravius, Daniël. 1661. Het Heylige Evangelium Matthei en Johannis ofte Hagnau Ka D'llig Matiktik. Ka na sasoulat ti Mattheus, ti Johannes appa. Overgeset inde Formosaansche tale, voor de Inwoonders van Soulang, Mattau, Sinckan, Bacloan, Tavocan en Tevorang. Amsterdam: Michiel Hartogh.

S.FORM: Ka mahkaula ta Pei-sasou-an ki tounnoun ki vullu-vullum ki Meirang ki sât-katallah-an, ka ni-t'pæpænæh dou madama ki papakalalam-eih tyn pa-ouvavaræuh tou atto-kakaræumætæg-han tyn.
S.TRANSL: For the kingdom of heaven is like unto a man that is an householder, which went out early in the morning to hire labourers into his vineyard.
「因為天國好像家主清早去雇人進他的葡萄園做工，

S.FORM: Irou ka ni-mææu-amsing mææu-kla ta sou tyn ki sou ki makka-lam-ah dou sasat ki wæ'i nda, sasat-ah ki malytouk, ni-paou-koua ta teni neni-æn tou atto-kakaræumætæg-han tyn.
S.TRANSL: And when he had agreed with the labourers for a penny a day, he sent them into his vineyard.
和工人講定一天一錢銀子，就打發他們進葡萄園去。

S.FORM: Irou ka ni-t'pæpænæh tou hivat ki kidi ki katatouro ki tæ'lei, ni-k'ytt'an tyn ta pani ki vouäl ka my-haoung mitouko tou pænæh.
S.TRANSL: And he went out about the third hour, and saw others standing idle in the marketplace,
約在巳初出去，看見市上還有閒站的人，

S.FORM: Ka ni-k'ma neini-æn, Nda ou-koua-au'ppa ymoumi tou atto-kakaræumætæg-han: râ kamamang ki pattæi-tiktik-eih, phæ-ei-mau-kamou-ra. Ka ni-mou-koua ta neni.
S.TRANSL: And said unto them; Go ye also into the vineyard, and whatsoever is right I will give you. And they went their way.
就對他們說：『你們也進葡萄園去，所當給的，我必給你們。』他們也進去了。

S.FORM: Irou ka ni-mila t'pæpænæh tou hivat ki kaanum ki kamamatoudda-appa ki tælei, mah-kaula ni-paou-koua tyn.
S.TRANSL: Again he went out about the sixth and ninth hour, and did likewise.
約在午正和申初又出去，也是這樣行。

S.FORM: Irou râ ni-t'pæpænæh tou hivat ki ka sasat kytti-æn 'æb' ki sât ki tæ'lei, ni-kabalei tyn ta rarouma ka pani ka my-haoung mitouko, ka ni-k'ma neini-æn, Kamang ta myhaoung-kamou mitouko hia makka sât ki wæ'i?
S.TRANSL: And about the eleventh hour he went out, and found others standing idle, and saith unto them, Why stand ye here all the day idle?
約在酉初出去，看見還有人站在那裏，就問他們說：『你們為甚麼整天在這裏閒站呢？』

S.FORM: Ni-k'ma tyni-æn, Alei ka assi kame ni-uddam ki saäät. Ni-k'ma ta teni neini-æn, Ou-koua-auppa ymoumi tou atto-kakaræumætæg-han, kamamang ka pattæ'i-tiktik-eih, arau-moumi-râ.
S.TRANSL: They say unto him, Because no man hath hired us. He saith unto them, Go ye also into the vineyard; and whatsoever is right, that shall ye receive.
他們說：『因為沒有人雇我們。』他說：『你們也進葡萄園去。』

S.FORM: Irou ka madoung-ato, ni-k'ma ta Meirang ki atto-kakaræumætæg-han ki Sih-koua tyn pouda-æuh, Tætæm-au ki makka-lalam, nda phæ-eito ki than-an nein ki ni-ou-varg-han, pæ'æ̈-ourou neini-æn ka ni-si-æ̈uh pæ'æ̈-kidi-appa ki ni-si-ourou.
S.TRANSL: So when even was come, the lord of the vineyard saith unto his steward, Call the labourers, and give them their hire, beginning from the last unto the first.
到了晚上，園主對管事的說：『叫工人都來，給他們工錢，從後來的起，到先來的為止。』

S.FORM: Nda jrou ka ni-mou-koua ta ni-papakalalam pæou-varæuh tou hivat ki kasasat kytti-æn 'æb ki sât ki tæ'lei, ni-â-sasat mara ki malyttouk ta saäat ki voual.
S.TRANSL: And when they came that were hired about the eleventh hour, they received every man a penny.
約在酉初雇的人來了，各人得了一錢銀子。

S.FORM: Irou ka mou-koua ta ni-si-ourou, ni-pou-rÿh ki â-saoun-eih nein mara, ka neni-appa ta saäat ni-mara ki sasat ki malyttouk.
S.TRANSL: But when the first came, they supposed that they should have received more; and they likewise received every man a penny.
及至那先雇的來了，他們以為必要多得；誰知也是各得一錢。

S.FORM: Ka rou ah-kaha mmara [ki anna,] ni-mææurmour-ato ki Tæ'i-tallagh.
S.TRANSL: And when they had received it, they murmured against the goodman of the house,
他們得了，就埋怨家主說：

S.FORM: Koun, Ni-si-æ̈ugh k'atta ni-mou-dyk mou-varæuh ki saat ki tæ'lei, ka ni-papæ-myh-kaulaula-en-hou ta neni ymi-an-an ka ni-tubhga-ni-æn ta mahimko ki maalting ka wæ'i.
S.TRANSL: Saying, These last have wrought but one hour, and thou hast made them equal unto us, which have borne the burden and heat of the day.
『我們整天勞苦受熱，那後來的只做了一小時，你竟叫他們和我們一樣嗎？』

S.FORM: Teni-râ ni-mattæ'i-vlli k'ma ki saat neini-æn, Diou, assi koh pæ'æ̈-toukol ymhou-an. Assi-kaua ni-mæuakla kow jau-an ki sou ki sasat ki malyttouk?
S.TRANSL: But he answered one of them, and said, Friend, I do thee no wrong: didst not thou agree with me for a penny?
家主回答其中的一人說：『朋友，我不虧負你，你與我講定的不是一錢銀子嗎？

S.FORM: Ar'au ta â-'mhou-ah, nda d'marang-ato. Mamoei-koh ki ni-si-æ̈ugh katta pæ'æ̈-mahkaulaula pi'æ ymhou-an.
S.TRANSL: Take that thine is, and go thy way: I will give unto this last, even as unto thee.
拿你的走吧！我給那後來的和給你一樣，這是我願意的。

S.FORM: Assi koh kaua hahei-en ka sykkounoung-ah-koh ki âjau? Assi lava mariang ta matta-uhou, alei ka mariang-koh?
S.TRANSL: Is it not lawful for me to do what I will with mine own? Is thine eye evil, because I am good?
我的東西難道不可隨我的意思用嗎？因為我作好人，你就紅了眼嗎？』

S.FORM: Kma hynna si-ourou-ah ta si-æ̈ugh, ka si-æ̈æugh-ah ta si-ourou. Ka madagh ta ni-tætææ̈m, râ matityng ta ni-peri.
S.TRANSL: So the last shall be first, and the first last: for many be called, but few chosen.
這樣，那在後的，將要在前；在前的，將要在後了。 」

S.FORM: Ka rou mi-vavau ta ti Jesus mou-Jerusalem, ni-patou-lalam tyn ta sât kytti-æn 'æb ki douha ki Pahtatæutæu-han tyn patou-sinnæh tou darang, ka ni-k'ma neini-æn,
S.TRANSL: And Jesus going up to Jerusalem took the twelve disciples apart in the way, and said unto them,
耶穌上耶路撒冷去的時候，在路上把十二個門徒帶到一邊，對他們說：

S.FORM: K'ytt'ei mou-vavau-kytta mou-Jerusalem, ka pæ'æ̈-tounnoun-an-eih ta Alak ki kaæuloung ki Sih-bavau ka Tama-p'higik ki Mahkou-sasoulat-appa, ka dmungding-ah tyni-æn ki pakapatei-eih.
S.TRANSL: Behold, we go up to Jerusalem; and the Son of man shall be betrayed unto the chief priests and unto the scribes, and they shall condemn him to death,
「看哪，我們上耶路撒冷去，人子要被交給祭司長和文士。他們要定他死罪，

S.FORM: Ka pæ'æ̈-tounnoun-ah tyni-æn ki Heidang tou ouroung-eih, tou angat-eih, tou pou-na-væværæ'-eih-da, tou katatouro ki wæ'i 'llikough-ah ta teni æhpit.
S.TRANSL: And shall deliver him to the Gentiles to mock, and to scourge, and to crucify him: and the third day he shall rise again.
又交給外邦人，將他戲弄，鞭打，釘在十字架上；第三日他要復活。」

S.FORM: Tou kidi k'anna irou-ato tyni-æn ta Raren'an ki alalak ti Zebedeus lam ki alalak tyn, tou pako-Alilid-en tou toumimi-en-appa ki mamang tyni-æn.
S.TRANSL: Then came to him the mother of Zebedees children with her sons, worshipping him, and desiring a certain thing of him.
那時，西庇太兒子的母親同她兩個兒子上前來拜耶穌，求他一件事。

S.FORM: Teni-râ ni-k'ma tyni-æn, mang ta kamoei-en-hou? Ni-k'ma tyni-æn, Pasousou-ei ka mierroung-ah ta rarouha ka alalak-au k'atta, ka saät-ah tou ouwal-ohou, ka saät-ah tou u-'ï-ohou tou Peisasou-an-ohou.
S.TRANSL: And he said unto her, What wilt thou? She saith unto him, Grant that these my two sons may sit, the one on thy right hand, and the other on the left, in thy kingdom.
耶穌說：「你要甚麼呢？」她說：「願你叫我這兩個兒子在你國裏，一個坐在你右邊，一個坐在你左邊。」

S.FORM: Râ ni-mattæ'i-v'lli ta ti Jesus, ni-k'ma, Assi-kamou mavana ka mang ta tou-mimi-'an-noumi: Moulpough-kamou kaua myt ki hæuugh ka yht-au-mau? ta'æulpough-en-kamou kaua mæulough ki Æuloug-han ka æuloug-eih-koh? Ni-k'ma tyni-æn, Mou-lpough-kame, ta'æu-lpough-en-kame.
S.TRANSL: But Jesus answered and said, Ye know not what ye ask. Are ye able to drink of the cup that I shall drink of, and to be baptized with the baptism that I am baptized with? They say unto him, We are able.
耶穌回答說：「你們不知道所求的是甚麼；我將要喝的杯，你們能喝嗎？」他們說：「我們能。」

S.FORM: Ka ni-k'ma ta teni neini-æn, Nda-hâh myt-ah-kamou ki hæuugh-au, æulough-eih-kamou ki æuloug-han ka æuloug-eih koh, râ pa-ierroung-in tou ouwal-au tou u'ï-appa-mau assi-mau sikakou-an ta p'hæn, râ [p'heih] neini-æn ka ni-si-tan-nin ti Rama-au.
S.TRANSL: And he saith unto them, Ye shall drink indeed of my cup, and be baptized with the baptism that I am baptized with: but to sit on my right hand, and on my left, is not mine to give, but it shall be given to them for whom it is prepared of my Father.
耶穌說：「我所喝的杯，你們必要喝；只是坐在我的左右，不是我可以賜的，乃是我父為誰預備的，就賜給誰。」

S.FORM: Irou ka millingigh ta sat kytti-æn [ka rarouma ki atta] ouhang ni-tna-væingbing ki rarouha ka mahtatæ'i-apara.
S.TRANSL: And when the ten heard it, they were moved with indignation against the two brethren.
那十個門徒聽見，就惱怒他們弟兄二人。

S.FORM: Ka rou ni-tmætææm ta ti Jesus neini-æn pa-ou-koua tyni-æn, ni-k'ma, Kavan'an-noumi ka Si-bavau ki tautaou ta mei-sasou neini-æn, ka Meireirang ta sihkakoua ki kailhgen neini-æn.
S.TRANSL: But Jesus called them unto him, and said, Ye know that the princes of the Gentiles exercise dominion over them, and they that are great exercise authority upon them.
耶穌叫了他們來，說：「你們知道外邦人有君王為主治理他們，有大臣操權管束他們。

S.FORM: Râ assi k'ma-ah-hynna ymouni-æn: râ timamang ymoumi-æn ta mamoei-ah kæuh-irang-en ki kidi, teni ta pa-iroung-au-moumi.
S.TRANSL: But it shall not be so among you: but whosoever will be great among you, let him be your minister;
只是在你們中間，不可這樣；你們中間誰願為大，就必作你們的用人；

S.FORM: Ka timamang ta mamoei-ah siouro ymoumi-æn, teni ta kouncia 'to moumi-ra.
S.TRANSL: And whosoever will be chief among you, let him be your servant:
誰願為首，就必作你們的僕人。

S.FORM: Mama ka assi ierrou-ato ta Alak ki ka'æuloung tou ierroung-eih tyni-æn, râ tou sau-mado-eih tyn mierroung, ka p'hæ-eil-appa ta vatti tyn tou t'æili-en mi-v'lli ki mabatoung.
S.TRANSL: Even as the Son of man came not to be ministered unto, but to minister, and to give his life a ransom for many.
正如人子來，不是要受人的服事，乃是要服事人，並且要捨命，作多人的贖價。」

S.FORM: Nda jrou ka 't pæpæpænæh ta neni tou Jerihgo, ni-mææuugh tyni-æn ta makoilalaulau ka mabatoung.
S.TRANSL: And as they departed from Jericho, a great multitude followed him.
他們出耶利哥的時候，有極多的人跟隨他。

S.FORM: Ka k'ytt'ei ta rarouha ki mavouta ka mierroung tou said ki darang, jrou ka millingigh ka hmarivat ta ti Jesus, ni-mako-lang-æh tmætææ̈m kommo-koua, Meirang ka na Alak ti David, maharumm-ato ymiæn-æn.
S.TRANSL: And, behold, two blind men sitting by the way side, when they heard that Jesus passed by, cried out, saying, Have mercy on us, O Lord, thou son of David.
有兩個瞎子坐在路旁，聽說是耶穌經過，就喊着說：「主啊，大衛的子孫，可憐我們吧！」

S.FORM: Râ ni-matymha ta makoilalaulau neini-æn, ka maipat-ah ta neni, râ ni-makou-saoun-appa mako-ton mako-lang-æh ta neni, mattæ'i-k'ma-hynna, Maharum-ma ymiæn-æn, Meirang ka na Alak ti David.
S.TRANSL: And the multitude rebuked them, because they should hold their peace: but they cried the more, saying, Have mercy on us, O Lord, thou son of David.
眾人責備他們，不許他們作聲；他們卻越發喊着說：「主啊，大衛的子孫，可憐我們吧！」

S.FORM: Ka rou rihkau mitouhko ta ti Jesus, ni-tmætææ̈m neini-æn, k'ma, Mang ta kamoei-'noumi ka pei-ringei-an-ei-mau-kamou?
S.TRANSL: And Jesus stood still, and called them, and said, What will ye that I shall do unto you?
耶穌就站住，叫他們來，說：「要我為你們做甚麼？」

S.FORM: Ni-k'ma ta neni tyni-æn, Meirang, ka pa-rkyllat-auh ta matta-jan.
S.TRANSL: They say unto him, Lord, that our eyes may be opened.
他們說：「主啊，要我們的眼睛能看見！」

S.FORM: Irou ka ma-ymmid maharafhaf ki na mavavohak ta ti Jesus [alei ki kaharum-man,] ni-smoukla ki matta nein, ka madis ni-kmytta ta matta nein, ka ni-mææuugh ta nein tyni-æn.
S.TRANSL: So Jesus had compassion on them, and touched their eyes: and immediately their eyes received sight, and they followed him.
耶穌就動了慈心，把他們的眼睛一摸，他們立刻看見，就跟從了耶穌。
